evidence_quotes: Bestuurlijke boete opgelegd wegens overtreding van de Meststoffenwet.
In geschil zijn de wijze van vaststellen van de begin- en eindvoorraad meststoffen
rationale: The decision concerns an administrative fine for violating the Dutch Fertilizers Act (Meststoffenwet), disputing manure stock accounting, sediment layers, pig phosphate retention from phosphate-rich feed, and fine proportionality. Under the protocol rules, agricultural manure and phosphate regulation disputes under the Meststoffenwet are NOT_WATER.
